subject.title: [TUI] Scroll-jump / auto-scroll behavior is still disruptive in 2026.3.8

question: Should the TUI preserve reader position by default, auto-follow only when already at the bottom, or add an explicit terminal auto-scroll mode?
rationale: The source path is credible, but the desired terminal behavior is a product choice because forced tail-follow, reader anchoring, and a new preference each change the user workflow differently.

options.title: Auto-follow only at bottom
options.body: Keep live-tail behavior for users already at the bottom while preserving reader position after manual scrollback.

options.title: Add a TUI auto-scroll setting
options.body: Expose a terminal preference, accepting the extra config/UI/docs surface and upgrade proof burden.

options.title: Patch renderer only
options.body: Remove disruptive redraw/scrollback behavior without adding user-facing controls or changing follow policy.

recommendation.title: Auto-follow only at bottom
recommendation.body: Keep live-tail behavior for users already at the bottom while preserving reader position after manual scrollback.
